Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
def reverse_in_place(values):
    left, right = 0, len(values) - 1
    while left < right:
        values[left], values[right] = values[right], values[left]
        left += 1; right -= 1
    return values

assert reverse_in_place([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [4, 3, 2, 1]
assert reverse_in_place([]) == []
```
explanation: Swap symmetric positions until the pointers meet. Time O(n), auxiliary space O(1); the list is modified in place.
